# Plan: the filter of the upcoming list, the trace gate, twelve requirements without a test (09/10/2026)

Approved by the product owner on 09/10/2026 (FE-24): "#1 and #3 ... are ok, go with the recommendation". Source:
section 0 of `apps/metis/reports/review/review.md` and the comparison report
`apps/metis/reports/review/spec-gaps.md`. Executed under FE-21; no commit.

## Decisions (controller)

- **R-T1 The filter of the upcoming list.** The API contract adds `attention.upcoming.drill` (the same kind of
  filter as the metric tile, BR-32); the "View in WBS" button and the "+ N more" row of this list copy that filter into
  the path (spec lines 225, 247). Mock data: `{ label: [milestone, approvalGate] }`, using only the WBS
  fields of the BRD. Question for the back-end: does "upcoming" also filter by date and status (BRD WBS-05
  has no date filter yet). Price if wrong: the server returns another filter, the screen does not change.
- **R-T2 The trace gate** (spec 9.1 rule 5): `gate:trace` runs `scripts/check-trace.mjs`, reads the
  `requirements` of every `src/screens/*/contract.yaml`, reads the names of all tests (`test`, `it`,
  `describe`, including `.each`) in `src/**/*.test.*` and `e2e/web/*.spec.ts` with the
  TypeScript parser, and goes red when an id has no test that carries it in its name. `pnpm verify` and CI call it by themselves because
  they run every `gate:*`. The contract of screen 24 adds `D-19` (BRD: Overview usable on phones).
- **R-T3 Missing measurements in the browser:** four controls of the contract never measured
  (`upcoming-row-*`, `upcoming-more`, `risks-more`, `state-back`); a keyboard test that walks through the whole page
  (shell, tabs, language select) and the state pages; the `role` and `nameKey` of the contract match the role and
  the accessible name; the page calls no server other than the app (self-hosted fonts); Newsreader uses the optical
  size that follows the font size.
- **R-T4 Reverse tests for the tool rules** (spec 10, `scripts/canary.mjs`): the import boundaries of
  `src/core` and `src/design-system`, the complexity ceiling, the file length ceiling, the reason when a rule is turned off, unused
  variables (strict TypeScript), Prettier, path types regenerated before `tsc`, text written directly in
  design system components.
- **R-T5 Default text in the design system** (spec 5.5): a lint rule forbidding text written directly in the JSX of
  `src/design-system`, with a reverse test.

## Steps

1. R-T1 in the test-first style: contract, mock data, model, screen contract, unit tests and
   browser tests.
2. R-T2: the script, the tests of the script (100% coverage), `gate:trace`.
3. R-T3: measurements in the browser; each measurement is proven red before it counts as done.
4. R-T4, R-T5: lint rules and reverse tests; run each new reverse test.
5. `pnpm verify` with all gates; update the spec (note at the end of the file), the review package, the handoff file.

## Rulings made during the run

- **R-T6 The `?mock=longLists` scenario** (`src/mocks/handlers.ts`): each attention list has a total greater than
  the number of rows sent back, which is three items, so that the "+ N more" row of all three lists appears and can be measured in the browser.
- **R-T7 The shared function for links** moves to `e2e/web/links.ts` (the filter is taken from the data of the very page
  being measured); the multi-page measurements and the keyboard test go in `e2e/web/controls.pages.spec.ts`, because
  `controls.spec.ts` would exceed the ceiling of 300 lines.
- **R-T8 The `role` type of the contract** narrows to `'link' | 'button' | 'tab'` (`e2e/web/contract.ts`):
  Playwright does not export a role type, so `toHaveRole` needs a narrow type; a new role is added there.
- **R-T9 The keyboard test waits for the sidebar.** The sidebar arrives through the shell's own call; at the first reverse
  test, when the machine was busy, the page had only 5 controls at the time of counting. Wait for `nav-myFocus` and only then count; 18 of 18
  repeated runs under parallel load were green.
- **R-T10 `plant()` of the reverse test creates the missing folder** and deletes exactly the folder it created when
  restoring the original state (the reverse test of the trace gate needs a fake screen `src/screens/99-canary`).
- **R-T11 The forbidden-syntax rules are declared once** (`restricted` in `eslint.config.js`): in the flat
  config of ESLint, a later block that sets `no-restricted-syntax` again for the same file replaces the list of the
  earlier block entirely, so the block of the design system must copy the whole old list again.
- **R-T12 Reverse test every new measurement** before it counts as done: breaking the contract temporarily (the filter of
  `risks-more`, the name key of `state-back`) turns the two measurements of the contract red; adding a Google Fonts tag and
  turning off the optical size in the `index.html` of the build turns the two font measurements red; the ten new reverse tests run
  on the real gate were all red for exactly the planted defect. Every file restored to its original state (compared with `cmp`).
- **A flaky failure seen once, mechanism not yet clear:** in one run of `gate:web`,
  `routes.spec.ts` ("each destination not built yet opens directly by a deep link") received a line
  `Failed to load resource: net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED`, that is a call to `api.metis.test` that leaked out to the
  network instead of going to the mock server. Not reproduced: 3 runs of the whole suite (324 test runs) and 40 separate runs under
  load. Hypothesis not yet checked: the browser stops the service worker of MSW when the machine is busy, and when it restarts it
  forgets the page being mocked. Next diagnostic step: write the address of the failed resource
  (`message.location().url`) into the message of `pageErrors`.

## The real run (09/10/2026, Mac of the user `mrpo`)

- `pnpm verify` eleven gates green (`apps/metis/reports/verify.md`): `gate:trace` 9 requirement ids, every id
  has a test that carries its name; 2.639 unit tests in 198 suites, coverage 100%; mutation testing 100%
  (1.363 mutants killed, 31 caught by timeout, 0 survived, 60 minutes 13 seconds); 167 tool tests;
  108 browser tests (100 before this batch, 8 added: three multi-page measurements, two font measurements,
  each on Chromium and WebKit, except the relocated keyboard test).
- Mutation testing run separately on the three code files of the batch (`handlers.ts`, `model.lists.ts`, `overview.ts`): 100%.
- Ten new reverse tests run on the real gate: all red for exactly the planted defect (R-T12).
- Files changed during the day: `.superpowers/narrow/changed-files.txt` (87 files, including the narrow-width part).
